post.title: [Hiring] Podcast editor - $30 per episode
post.body: Weekly 40-minute interview podcast. Need someone to remove ums and dead air, balance levels, add intro/outro music and export the episode plus a 60-second teaser. $30 per episode, ongoing.

analysis.summary: Edit a weekly 40-minute interview podcast (clean-up, levels, music) and cut a 60-second teaser; $30 per episode, ongoing.

expect: mentions podcast editing or the teaser
does not claim audio mastering skills not in evidence
